names.name: Biscuits and gravy
names.said: A styrofoam clamshell, a plastic fork, and a queue that is not there for donuts.

text.what: Soft wheat biscuits split and covered in a white gravy built on sausage drippings, flour and milk.
text.story: The dish is an American breakfast staple of the South, built out of cheap ingredients — biscuits made without yeast, gravy made from what was left in the pan.
text.today: Southern donut counters that open at five sell it beside the case, on the same argument every other second menu rests on.
